title: Hard disk drive
prompt: a 3.5-inch hard disk drive with the lid off, modelled large: power on, the platters spin up, read a file and the arm seeks across the tracks, park the heads; see-through shows the spindle motor, platters, actuator arm, voice coil, read heads, controller board and SATA connector
blurb: Power on a 3.5-inch hard drive to spin its platters up to 7200 rpm, then pick a file and watch the voice coil swing the arm across the tracks while the heads fly on air and the bits stream out to the SATA port.
